info.name: BG4.B - POS Order Handoff (Split / Merge / Transfer / Move)
info.description:
BG4.B collection. Validates the six new POS order handoff endpoints introduced in `apps/api/src/modules/pos-handoff`:

- `POST /api/pos/orders/:id/split-bill` — non-physical bill split (EQUAL or CUSTOM). Persists groups in `Order.metadata.splitBill`. No item / status mutation. Audits `ORDER_SPLIT_BILL`.
- `POST /api/pos/orders/:id/split-items` — physical split. Creates a child `Order` in NEW status with `splitFromOrderId = source.id`. Reparents whole rows or splits a row when partial. Source KDS tickets are PRESERVED and metadata-marked (`bg4bSupersededBy`). Child order is NOT auto-republished — operator must POST `/:id/send` explicitly. Audits `ORDER_SPLIT_ITEMS` + `ORDER_SPLIT_CHILD_CREATED`.
- `POST /api/pos/orders/merge` — absorb source into target. Source becomes `VOIDED` with `mergedIntoOrderId = target.id`. Blocks (409 `MERGE_SOURCE_HAS_PAYMENTS`) if source has any PENDING/COMPLETED payments. Source KDS tickets metadata-marked (`bg4bMergedInto`). Audits `ORDER_MERGED` once on each side.
- `POST /api/pos/orders/:id/transfer-table` — reassigns `Order.tableId`. Audits `ORDER_TRANSFERRED_TABLE`.
- `POST /api/pos/orders/:id/transfer-server` — reassigns `Order.userId`. Validates target user has an ACTIVE Membership in the same branch. Audits `ORDER_TRANSFERRED_SERVER`.
- `POST /api/pos/orders/:id/move-items` — partial transfer of items between two open orders. Mirrors split-items semantics; KDS tickets metadata-marked (`bg4bItemsMovedTo`). Audits `ORDER_ITEMS_MOVED` once on each side.

All six endpoints are wrapped via the BG3 reliability facade (`Bg3ReliabilityService.guard`) with `category: null` and `idempotencyMode: 'optional'`. Replays of `Idempotency-Key` return the exact cached response body.

Locked rules verified:
- `/api/auth/me` remains canonical context source (R14).
- `POST /api/auth/login` accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- New permissions: `pos:order:split | pos:order:merge | pos:order:transfer | pos:order:move-items`.
- Owner / Manager / Cashier get all four. Waiter gets only `transfer` + `move-items` (split + merge are cashier-scope). **Chef intentionally denied** to verify role gating still enforces 403.
- Public diner payments still PENDING (out of scope).
- PesaPal owner-SaaS-only (out of scope).
- No hotel structures.
- Schema additive only: two nullable self-FKs on `Order` (`splitFromOrderId`, `mergedIntoOrderId`) + 2 indexes. No destructive change.
- KDS strategy: PRESERVE-AND-MARK source tickets; destination requires explicit re-`/send`.

⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.** Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time.

request.description:
⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.**

## Run order (each folder is [STANDALONE] thanks to per-folder fixture creation)
1. **A. Auth & Context Baseline** — login owner + canonical /api/auth/me + login chef.
2. **B. Split Bill** — non-physical EQUAL split + CUSTOM-mismatch 400.
3. **C. Split Items** — physical partial split + idempotency replay.
4. **D. Merge Orders** — happy-path merge + 409 self-merge / payments-block.
5. **E. Transfer Table** — happy-path table reassignment.
6. **F. Transfer Server** — happy-path server reassignment + 403 invalid user.
7. **G. Move Items** — happy-path cross-order item move.
8. **H. Permission Denial — Chef** — chef → 403 on every handoff endpoint.
9. **I. Edge Cases** — order-not-open conflict (409 `ORDER_NOT_OPEN_FOR_HANDOFF`).

## Auto-populated variables
- `accessToken`, `chefToken`, `orgId`, `branchId` (from login + /api/auth/me).
- `bg4bSuffix`, `idemKeySplitItems`, `idemKeyMerge` (per-run).
- `menuItemId` (auto-resolved via `GET /api/menu/items`).
- `tableId`, `altTableId` (auto-resolved via `GET /api/tables`).
- `altUserId` (auto-resolved via `GET /api/orgs/:o/branches/:b/memberships`).
- `fixture*OrderId` and `fixture*ItemId` are written by each folder's first request (fixture creation).

## Locked rules verified
- `/api/auth/me` canonical (R14).
- BG3 facade reused for all 6 endpoints (`category: null`, `idempotencyMode: 'optional'`).
- New `pos:order:{split,merge,transfer,move-items}` perms; chef denied.
- Schema additive only: two nullable self-FKs on `Order`.
- KDS PRESERVE-AND-MARK; destination requires explicit `/send`.
- Public diner payments still PENDING (untouched here).
- PesaPal owner-SaaS-only (untouched here).
- No hotel structures.
